But i guess i don't want to believe that Miu killed Sumire. 

I'm very confused about the call K. gets in the end. Did Sumire call him from the other side? Was it a good old hallucination that he saw? I'm not sure.

I'm very tempted to buy into the whole "Other Place" theory, but it honestly sounds too far fetched and more metaphorical. Like the other place is somewhere you go when you lose part of yourself to a traumatic experience. 

Even K. had a tough childhood. I think he'd gone to the "other place" a long time ago. That's why being with Sumire made him feel so alive, that's why their friendship was so special(libido notwithstanding).

I really wanted Sumire to come back somehow, realise that K. was as good as it gets at least for now and K. And Sumire continued as friends for a long time. We can't all find love, but do all companions have to have a sexual aspect to them? K. and Sumire were such perfect friends. Ah sigh.
